title: Storm Squad Leadership Training | Kids Martial Arts Learning to Lead (Respect • Protect • Empower)
caption:
Today our Storm Squad students stepped into a special leadership training session at Engage Lifestyle Martial Arts, and the results were incredible.

For three hours, our students (ages 9–15) trained not just as martial artists, but as leaders and teammates. The focus of the day was our Storm Squad leadership code:

Respect • Protect • Empower

Students practiced real leadership skills through partner drills, games, and coaching exercises. They learned how to encourage teammates, communicate clearly, and take responsibility for each other’s safety during training.

A big highlight of the class was watching our HEROES leadership team (ages 12–18) guide the groups. These advanced students modeled what leadership looks like by demonstrating drills, encouraging their teammates, and helping everyone improve.

The training finished with focus mitts, kick shields, and heavy bag rounds where students practiced not only striking skills, but also how to coach and motivate their partners like true leaders.

Classes like this help students build confidence, communication, and teamwork while growing into strong martial artists and future leaders.

Storm Squad leaders always…

Respect. Protect. Empower.

title: Instructor completes amazing accomplishment with unexpected partner.
caption:
In 1989, I started martial arts with my father right here in Las Vegas.

We trained together, earned our black belts together, and went through all the ups and downs that come with a lifelong journey in the arts. For most of our lives, we’ve stood side by side as black belts—teaching, training, and giving back to the art that gave us so much.

Last night, we hit another milestone together. Earning my seventh-degree black belt was never something I dreamed about as a kid. Honestly, anything beyond fifth degree always felt like it belonged to someone else, while I was just busy living out my dream.

But here we are—years later—still doing what we love, still side by side, and still growing. To be able to celebrate this moment with my father and my family means more than words can explain.

I know many people who’ve had the honor of being taught by their parents in martial arts—but not many who’ve had the journey I’ve had. To do it with my dad, to grow with him, to accomplish things together—that’s a rare blessing.

It’s been one amazing ride.
#engagelifestylemartialarts #engagelifestyle #weengagelife #karatefamily #karatefamily #karatedaddy

Speaking on leadership isn’t just a responsibility—it’s one of my greatest passions. I’m grateful to share what I’ve learned, and even more grateful to get caught in the moment doing what I love.

Let’s keep building. Let’s keep leading. Let’s stay legendary.

title: Kids Karate - Ages 5-6 - Mini Ninjas Program at CD Young's Karate in Henderson
caption:
CD Young's Karate in Henderson

Children this age are in a unique growth period in their life. They are refined in their gross motor skills, while establishing a foundation in basic fundamental skills. These basic fundamental skills include: focus, teamwork, control, balance, memory, discipline, fitness, and coordination. In any other sport of activity, all of these 8 skills are important to have. The more exposure to proper development in each of these skills, the better your child will be. For this reason, we have tailored fundamentals training course that increases the intensity of each skill

at every level.


In the Basic SKILLZ Program, your child will train in an environment that is just right for them. They will train with other children in their age group, and not have to be limited or overwhelmed by younger and older children. Each class will accommodate every student’s skills and abilities in a way that is not overly demanding or intimidating. That means more age specific instruction with better results. We guarantee it!

title: Kids Karate for Ages 3 5 - Ninja Tots Program at CD Young's Karate in Henderson
caption:
CD Young's Karate in Henderson

Children between the ages of 3 and 5 years old are in a very distinct growing stage. They are embarking on new discoveries everyday and learning how to cope with all of the challenges. Their intellect, emotions, physical capabilities, and social competence all are growing at a rapid rate. So fast, that they often overlook what’s important and can hardly tell the difference between right and wrong.

That’s where the Early SKILLZ Program comes into play. Our program was specially designed for the stages of development of 3 and 5 year olds. We collected scientific and psychological resources regarding this age group, and used that information to ensure that our program meets each child’s characteristics and capabilities.

title: Kids Karate for ages 7-9 - Core Skillz Program at CD Young's Karate in Henderson
caption:
CD Young's Karate in Henderson

This program was specifically designed to target the stages of development of 7 to 9-year olds. The curriculum in the Core SKILLZ Program includes years of research and development proven effective for this age group. Our goal for the Core SKILLZ Program is to maximize the effectiveness of each participants training with valuable lessons that will enhance their life.


Children this age are in a unique growth period in their life. They are refined in their gross motor skills, while establishing a foundation in core skill development. These core skills include: agility, technique, courage, flexibility, intensity, perseverance, speed, and concentration. In any other sport of activity, all of these 8 skills are important to have. The more exposure to proper development in each of these skills, the better your child will be. For this reason, we have tailored a training course that increases the intensity of each skill at every level.

title: Karate for Teens Ages 10-14 - Extreme Skillz Program at CD Young’s Karate in Henderson
caption:
This program was specifically designed to target the stages of development of 10 to 14 year olds. The curriculum in the Extreme SKILLZ Program includes years of research and development proven effective for this age group. Our goal for the Extreme SKILLZ Program is to maximize the effectiveness of each participants training with valuable lessons that will enhance their life.

The Extreme SKILLZ Program is a preliminary Martial Arts training course that focuses on building 10 to 14 year olds capabilities; physically, emotionally, socially, and intellectually. We call this program “Extreme” SKILLZ because it will help each student properly develop extreme skills they are currently acquiring at this age. We are confident in what our program can do for your son or daughter.

People this age are in a unique growth period in their life. They are refined in their gross and fine motor skills, while establishing a foundation in extreme skill development. These extreme skills include: dexterity, reaction, versatility, momentum, precision, instinct, strength, and vision. In any other sport of activity, all of these 8 skills are important to have. The more exposure to proper development in each of these skills, the better your son or daughter will be. For this reason, we have tailored a 9-level training course that increases the intensity of each skill at every level.

title: Dojo Re-Opening Protocols and Enter/Exit Procedures
caption:
Reopening - Enter/Exit Procedures

Before coming to class.  
- Wash Your Feet and Hands Thoroughly.  
- YOU must wear clean flip flops or Clean Socks and Shoes to enter.  No Student will be permitted without shoes.
- GO TO THE BATHROOM before class.  Although we will allow for emergencies, we MUST clean the bathroom after every use, so we prefer that you go before you come to class.

When you arrive:
1) Bring your Waiver (or pen if you can't print), Water Bottle, Shoes and Socks.
NO BAGS, Equipment, or any additional items permitted at this time.  A small purse for adults, keys, wallets and phones will be permitted during class.

2) Arrive 10-15 minutes early.  Our goal is to start class RIGHT ON TIME, so entry will be started at the 10 minute mark for class.  NO LATE ARRIVALS will be permitted during class.

3) We will ask you screening questions, take your temperature, and move you to the class.

4) Upon entry, you will remove your shoes and go to your training station.  Sanitizer will be given one more time and class will begin.

5) Class will end at the 30 minute mark.  Parents should park in the back and pickup students.   Please do not gather during pickup as our goal is to create safety with our social distancing and safety procedures.
